criteria.reason: The controller node owns attemptNumber, retriesConsumed and startTime; the operation is a separate caller-provided input.
The loop invokes input(attemptNumber), returns its value, and routes thrown/rejected errors into the failure controller.
The hooks are ordered shouldConsumeRetry, onFailedAttempt, guards, shouldRetry; consume=false loops without delay/count consumption, while remaining time and retriesLeft guard continuation.
The rejection path names retry-time/count exhaustion, shouldRetry=false and non-network TypeError rejection.
AbortError unwraps originalError; AbortSignal is checked around input and cancels a pending delay, while input receives only attemptNumber.
The timer is bounded by maxTimeout and remaining maxRetryTime, with Infinity represented as no cap; the retry loop and no-deadline-on-running-input distinction are explicit.
Roles, branches and conclusion cards are source backed; excluded jitter formula, option wording and wrapper details are not asserted.
